text: Confirmed and clarified the internal path for ravel-laws: both platforms have publish / skip true, publishLocalSnapshot names only core, the current helpers/two constant Discipline properties have no compatibility or conformance promise, and MiMa comments now target core only. Positive evidence: sbt fmtCheck verifyCoreReleaseMatrix verifyPublishArtifacts plus scripts/verify-publish-artifacts.sh passed and emitted only ravel-core JVM/Scala.js coordinates. Negative evidence: overriding lawsJVM publish / skip to false made verifyCoreReleaseMatrix fail explicitly on lawsJVM. Prior local snapshot receipt emitted only ravel-core_3 and ravel-core_sjs1_3.
